title: Update dependency autoprefixer to v10.6.1
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Change | [Age](https://docs.renovatebot.com/merge-confidence/) | [Confidence](https://docs.renovatebot.com/merge-confidence/) |
|---|---|---|---|
| [autoprefixer](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer) | [`10.5.0` → `10.6.1`](https://renovatebot.com/diffs/npm/autoprefixer/10.5.0/10.6.1) | ![age](https://developer.mend.io/api/mc/badges/age/npm/autoprefixer/10.6.1?slim=true) | ![confidence](https://developer.mend.io/api/mc/badges/confidence/npm/autoprefixer/10.5.0/10.6.1?slim=true) |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>postcss/autoprefixer (autoprefixer)</summary>

### [`v10.6.1`](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#1061)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/compare/10.6.0...10.6.1)

- Fixed grid gap set with the row-gap and column-gap longhands (by dualfroz).

### [`v10.6.0`](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#1060-Post-tenebras-lux)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/compare/10.5.6...10.6.0)

- Added `initial-letter` support (by [@​thomasmattheussen](https://redirect.github.com/thomasmattheussen)).

### [`v10.5.6`](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#1056)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/compare/10.5.5...10.5.6)

- Fixed producing wrong old `-webkit-` gradients (by [@​ryanchou1994](https://redirect.github.com/ryanchou1994)).

### [`v10.5.5`](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#1055)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/compare/10.5.4...10.5.5)

- Fixed resolution media query parsing performance (by [@​NotAFlightRisk](https://redirect.github.com/NotAFlightRisk)).

### [`v10.5.4`](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#1054)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/compare/10.5.3...10.5.4)

- Fixed prefixed rule duplication (by [@​xianjianlf2](https://redirect.github.com/xianjianlf2)).

### [`v10.5.3`](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#1053)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/compare/10.5.2...10.5.3)

- Fixed brackets and gradient parser ([@​alanturing881](https://redirect.github.com/alanturing881)).

### [`v10.5.2`](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#1052)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/compare/10.5.1...10.5.2)

- Moved `-webkit-fill-available` before `-moz-available`, so Firefox
  will use `-webkit-` version which is closer to `stretch`.

### [`v10.5.1`](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#1051)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/postcss/autoprefixer/compare/10.5.0...10.5.1)

- Fixed `grid-area` span reset for overriding areas (by [@​puneetdixit200](https://redirect.github.com/puneetdixit200)).

</details>
